notes.name: BetterBench
finding: A lifecycle framework makes benchmark practices inspectable, from construction to maintenance.
以生命週期框架檢查 benchmark 的建置、報告與維護實務。
boundary: Good documentation does not establish predictive validity. Practice and benchmark counts differ across source versions, so no count is quoted here.
文件完整不等於有預測效度；不同版本的實務項目與 benchmark 數不一致，此處不引用該組數字。

notes.name: Measuring what Matters
finding: Examines whether tasks and scores support the capabilities that benchmark descriptions claim to measure.
檢查 benchmark 的任務與分數，是否足以支持它宣稱測量的能力。
boundary: An audit of a sample does not establish that every benchmark is invalid.
對一批 benchmark 的檢查，不能延伸成所有 benchmark 都無效。

notes.name: Benchmarking the Benchmarks · Predictive validity
finding: Uses held-out model families to test whether commonsense scores predict downstream tasks; transfer depends on the target task.
保留未見模型家族，檢查常識測試能否預測下游任務；預測力取決於目標任務。
boundary: A stronger correlation on one task does not establish broad real-world competence.
對某任務較高的相關性，不等於普遍的真實世界能力。

notes.name: Benchmarking the Benchmarks · Conversational agents
target: 一致性、複雜度與政策涵蓋
finding: Checks benchmark-quality measures against independent annotations and deliberately degraded benchmark variants.
以獨立標註與刻意退化的 benchmark 版本，驗證 benchmark 品質指標。
boundary: Controlled degradation is close prior art for audit validation; injecting defects alone is not a new idea.
受控退化已是稽核驗證的相關先例；光是注入缺陷，並不是新想法。

notes.name: BenchBench
finding: Compares benchmark designers through generated items, answerer panels and item-quality checks.
用生成題目、多模型作答與題目品質檢查，比較 benchmark 設計者。
boundary: The evaluated object is the generator; another occurrence of “bench” does not automatically add a meta-evaluation level.
被評的是出題者；名稱多一個 bench，不代表自動多一層 meta-evaluation。

notes.name: GateTruth
target: RTL 測試平台的嚴謹度
finding: Introduces mutations to test whether a hardware benchmark detects meaningful design defects.
刻意加入變異，檢查硬體 benchmark 能否抓到有意義的設計缺陷。
boundary: Hardware evidence motivates an audit design; it is not empirical evidence about speech benchmarks.
硬體領域的結果可啟發設計，但不是語音 benchmark 的實證。

notes.name: JudgeBench
finding: Tests whether judges distinguish correct from incorrect answers in difficult answer pairs.
用困難的答案對，檢查 judge 能否分辨正確與錯誤。
boundary: A capable judge cannot by itself establish test-set representativeness or downstream validity.
好的 judge 本身不能證明測試集具代表性，也不能包辦下游效度。

notes.name: Can We Trust Item Response Theory?
finding: Uses simulated data with known parameters to test IRT inference under the small-model, large-item regimes common in AI evaluation.
在已知生成參數的模擬資料中，檢驗 IRT 在模型少、題目多的評估情境下是否可靠。
boundary: Simulation validates inference under specified assumptions, not every real benchmark population.
模擬只能驗證指定假設下的推論，無法代表所有真實 benchmark 母體。

notes.name: metabench
finding: Uses item response theory to build a sparse instrument that reconstructs scores on a larger benchmark suite.
以試題反應理論建立稀疏測試，重建較大型測試組合的分數。
boundary: Reconstructing the original scores tests fidelity to that reference, not whether the reference measures the right thing.
重現原始分數驗證的是保真度，未回答原始測試是否量到對的能力。

notes.name: tinyBenchmarks
finding: Selects a small item set to estimate the outcomes of substantially larger evaluations.
挑選少量題目，估計較大型評測的結果。
boundary: Efficiency and construct validity are separate questions.
效率與構念效度是兩個需要分開回答的問題。

notes.name: MiniSUPERB
finding: Tests whether a lightweight speech benchmark preserves rankings from its full reference evaluation.
檢查輕量語音 benchmark 能否保留完整參考評測的模型排名。
boundary: Rank fidelity to SUPERB is not a guarantee of performance on every intended use.
對 SUPERB 排名的保真度，不保證每一種實際用途的表現。

notes.name: All That Glitters Is Not Audio
finding: Examines whether audio-language evaluation actually requires auditory information.
檢查 audio-language 評估是否真的需要聽覺資訊。
boundary: Audio removal can change the input distribution; use matched controls before attributing a score difference to a mechanism.
移除音訊也可能改變輸入分布；需要配對對照，才能解讀分數差異的原因。

notes.name: The Fallacy of Global Token Perplexity
target: 語音模型的評估估計器
finding: Questions the interpretation of global token perplexity when evaluating spoken language models.
檢視 global token perplexity 用於 spoken language model 評估時的解讀問題。
boundary: The choice of estimator is part of the capability claim, not a neutral reporting detail.
估計器的選擇是能力主張的一部分，不只是中性的報告細節。

notes.name: Reporting Subjective TTS Evaluation
finding: Argues for more rigorous reporting of the details behind subjective TTS evaluations.
主張更嚴謹地交代 TTS 主觀評估的流程細節。
boundary: Human ratings also depend on instructions, participants and experimental conditions.
人類評分也取決於指示、受試者與實驗條件。

notes.name: VoiceMOS Challenge 2022
target: 人類語音品質評分的預測器
finding: Evaluates MOS predictors against listening-test ratings, including an out-of-domain track.
以聽測評分評估 MOS 預測器，並包含分布外測試。
boundary: This is an established speech meta-evaluation precedent; agreement with MOS is bounded by the listening protocol.
這是既有語音 meta-evaluation 先例；與 MOS 的一致性仍受聽測流程界定。

notes.name: t-DCF
target: Metrics for a combined verification system
組合式驗證系統的指標
finding: Evaluates anti-spoofing together with speaker verification using explicit costs and trial priors.
納入明確成本與試驗先驗，把防偽與語者驗證一起評估。
boundary: An isolated component’s equal error rate may not predict the combined system’s deployment cost.
單一元件的 equal error rate，不一定預測組合系統部署時的成本。

notes.name: Full-Duplex-Bench-v3
target: Candidate external tasks for voice agents
語音代理的外部任務候選
finding: Studies tool use for full-duplex voice agents under disfluent interactions.
研究不流暢互動情境下，全雙工語音代理的工具使用。
boundary: Context for a proposed external criterion, not an unquestionable ground truth or a benchmark-quality audit itself.
可作為外部效標的起點；本身不是無可質疑的標準答案，也不是 benchmark 品質稽核。

notes.name: The Benchmark Lottery
target: 對 benchmark 選擇的依賴
finding: Explores how benchmark choices shape which models appear successful.
探討 benchmark 的選擇，如何影響哪些模型被視為成功。
boundary: State the tasks and aggregation weights before interpreting an overall ranking.
解讀總排名前，應先交代任務選擇與彙整權重。

notes.name: Adaptive Data Analysis and Holdout Reuse
finding: Studies the generalization risks of adaptively reusing a holdout set.
研究自適應地重複使用 holdout 資料時的泛化風險。
boundary: Adaptive overfitting and training-data contamination are different failure paths.
反覆依測試回饋最佳化，與訓練資料污染，是不同的失效途徑。

notes.name: MixEval
target: 測試混合與外部一致性
finding: Builds benchmark mixtures and examines their relationship to external model rankings.
建構 benchmark 混合，並檢查它與外部模型排名的關係。
boundary: Agreement with another leaderboard inherits that leaderboard’s population, task and preference scope.
與另一排行榜一致，也承接了該排行榜的人群、任務與偏好範圍。

notes.name: Testing Statistical Significance in NLP
finding: Organizes statistical testing choices around NLP tasks and evaluation measures.
依 NLP 任務與評估指標，整理統計檢定方法的選擇。
boundary: Speech observations may share speakers, listeners or sessions; independence cannot simply be assumed.
語音觀測可能共享語者、聽者或場次，不能直接假設彼此獨立。

notes.name: From Static to Dynamic Evaluation
finding: Surveys approaches to benchmarking under data contamination, including dynamic evaluation.
整理資料污染下的 benchmark 方法，包含動態評測。
boundary: Refreshing a benchmark can reduce one risk without establishing its overall validity.
更新題目可以降低某種風險，但不會自動證明整體效度。

notes.name: Benchmark Science and Engineering
target: 將 benchmarking 本身當成研究對象
finding: Makes an early case for studying benchmark principles and hierarchies across fields.
較早提出跨領域研究 benchmark 原理與層級的方向。
boundary: A conceptual precedent, not experimental evidence for a new speech audit.
這是概念先例，不是新語音稽核方法的實驗證據。

notes.name: BenchScope
finding: Asks how many independent signals a benchmark contributes to model evaluation.
追問一個 benchmark 對模型評估提供了多少獨立訊號。
boundary: Novel information and agreement with a reference answer different questions; neither should be a universal quality score.
新資訊與重現參考結果回答不同問題，兩者都不宜直接當成通用品質分數。
